about_the_game:
A Radio Tower in the remote, isolated countryside is your next assignment. What appears to be a quick repair job quickly spirals into a dreadful ordeal. No one has seen the previous Technician and the Corporation has sent you alone to fix this mess.

The Assignment from your Superiors

  • Fix computer terminals, generators, and ventilation systems.

  • Use a variety of specialised tools, engineering equipment, scanners, radios and your technical prowess to restore the facility functionality.

  • You're entirely alone - your assignment will only finish once the radio tower is operational.

  • Whatever lurks in the darkness - watching and stalking you - threatens to sabotage your mission. It will not hesitate to seek you out... and annihilate you at any moment.

Demo Game Features

  • Demo finishes after the 'Find basement key' quest.

  • Crowbar and UV scanner available to explore and progress through the environment.

  • Roughly 10-15 minutes of gameplay depending on exploration and puzzle completion time.

  • Face up against an adversary that evolves and shifts its behaviour based on your actions.

  • Randomised and unpredictable events will mean no two playthroughs will ever be the same.

content_descriptors.notes: Depictions of violence, gore and mutilation. Strong themes of psychosis and paranoia.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Later
  • Processor: 2.4GHZ Dual Core Processor Or Higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 670 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.4 GHZ Quad Core Processor Or Higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: A conspiracy is being broadcast across the airwaves. You the Technician, must restore an offline radio tower and uncover how unknown frequencies are being emitted from an empty and seemingly abandoned facility.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
